description: Single sensors with their latest reading (PM1, PM2.5, PM10, temperature, humidity, pressure), network and quality check: status, rating 0–10 of the last checked day, the mean rating of the last 7 days and the reasons. Filter by city, country, or a point with a radius; sort=rating puts the most reliable sensors first.

city.description: City slug like "serbia/belgrade" or the Atmy city id (find it with search_cities).

country.description: Country slug, the first part of a city slug, e.g. "serbia".

lat.description: With lon: sensors within radius_km of this point.

min_rating.description: Only sensors with at least this rating on their last checked day.

quality.description: passed: only sensors that pass the quality check.

name: find_sensors
title: Find sensors
